data.gist: The authors' prior work showed BMAX from subcortical bone cores retains ECM and yields MSCs with higher abundance, adherence, proliferation, and a more pro-regenerative secretome than BMAC.
data.plain: Previously the group described harvesting subcortical bone cores and processing them with minimal agitation during surgery so native matrix is retained. In lab studies this BMAX product had relatively more stem cells, better attachment and growth, and secreted a more regeneration-favoring mix of factors than matched BMAC.
